correctness.rationale: The source identity for the transformed controlled-frame operator is WSW*. Surjectivity of W is equivalent to W* being bounded below, so alpha I <= S <= beta I gives alpha m(W*)^2 I <= WSW* <= beta ||W||^2 I. Conversely, onto-ness of WSW* forces onto-ness of W because R(WSW*) is contained in R(W). The explicit backward-shift example is an exact Parseval calculation and shows noninjectivity is compatible with the transformed frame property.

value.rationale: The error changes an iff theorem retained in publication: it incorrectly excludes every surjective noninjective operator. The backward-shift example preserves Parseval tightness and avoids zero transformed atoms, while the repair supplies the exact operator condition and quantitative frame bounds. This is a structural correction rather than a cosmetic constant improvement.
